summary: Demand Planning and Forecasting is the strategic process of estimating future customer demand to align supply chain resources, financial goals, and operational
lede: Demand Planning and Forecasting helps professionals estimate future customer demand by combining historical data, market intelligence, and statistical algorithms. This advanced course shows you how to align supply chain resources, financial goals, and operational capacity while balancing inventory carrying costs with service levels. You will apply methods including Holt-Winters, ARIMA, demand sensing, bias analysis, and AI-assisted outlier detection across complex, multi-echelon supply chains. You will also build S&OP consensus workflows, develop demand shaping strategies, and use measures such as MAPE, WMAPE, and FVA to communicate forecast accuracy, risk, and opportunity.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for experienced supply chain professionals who are responsible for the accuracy of demand signals and the alignment of supply with market requirements.
modules: Strategic Alignment: IBP and S&OP Frameworks
Advanced Statistical Modeling: Beyond Moving Averages
AI and Machine Learning in Predictive Forecasting
Demand Sensing and Real-Time Market Intelligence
